SessionStart.description: A plan usage limit already crossed before this session's first tool call
Repoint this package's status line and subagent status line at the current plugin root after a version bump; silent unless something changed
Bring ~/.claude/rules up to this version after an upgrade, by the shipped-rules ledger (ADR 0079); an edited rule is left and named once; silent unless something changed
Hand a fresh session the open handoff item left on the deck for this directory, once, so a pilot that ran out of context resumes on /clear with nothing pasted; silent when there is none

PreToolUse.description: Stamp who wrote a deck message from the hook payload's agent_type, overwriting any author the agent gave (spec 2 of run-record, ADR 0027)

PostToolUse.description: One process after every tool call: a reply waiting on the deck, and a plan usage limit about to be spent

PermissionRequest.description: Refuse a permission prompt raised by this plugin's own crew agents (L17), and the pilot session's while a run is live in its directory (gate-no-stall L10), with the blocked-step instruction, and post every refusal to the deck as a blocked item; other sessions' and other agents' prompts are left to the user

PermissionDenied.description: Post a call auto mode denied to the pilot or its crew during a live run as one blocking question on the live ticket, once per session and command, so a blocked step reaches the deck within the hook turn; never answers retry

Stop.description: Refuse to let the pilot go idle on the deck: hold the turn open while its own question is unanswered, and block on an answer it has not read
